tools.name: evaluate_expression
tools.description:
Evaluate a simple ExtendScript expression and return its value. Use for quick queries like checking a property, getting a count, or reading state. The expression should be a single value/call — NOT a full script.

Examples:
- "app.project.name" → project name
- "app.project.activeSequence.name" → active sequence name
- "app.project.rootItem.children.numItems" → number of root items
- "app.project.activeSequence.videoTracks.numTracks" → number of video tracks
- "app.version" → Premiere Pro version

Inspect a Premiere Pro DOM object and list its properties, methods, and values. Useful for exploring the API and debugging.

Examples:
- "app.project" → project properties
- "app.project.activeSequence" → sequence properties
- "app.project.activeSequence.videoTracks[0].clips[0]" → first clip on V1
- "app.project.activeSequence.videoTracks[0].clips[0].components[0]" → first component of a clip

object_path.description: Dot-path to the DOM object to inspect (e.g., 'app.project.activeSequence')

max_depth.description: Max depth for nested inspection (default: 1, max: 3)

tools.name: list_clip_effects
tools.description: List all effects/components on a clip with their properties and current values. Essential for debugging effect issues.

node_id.description: Node ID of the clip to inspect

tools.name: get_sequence_structure
tools.description: Get a complete structural overview of the active sequence: all tracks, all clips with positions, gaps, and clip metadata. Essential for understanding timeline state before making edits.

sequence_id.description: Sequence name or ID. Uses active sequence if omitted.

tools.name: get_premiere_state
tools.description: Get a comprehensive snapshot of the current Premiere Pro state: project info, active sequence, playhead position, selected clips, and available sequences. The best first call to understand the current context.

tools.name: select_clips_by_name
tools.description: Select all clips in the active sequence that match a name (substring match). Optionally filter by track type and index.

name.description: Clip name to search for (case-insensitive substring match)

track_index.description: Specific track index to search (optional, searches all if omitted)

add_to_selection.description: If true, add to existing selection instead of replacing it (default: false)

tools.name: select_all_clips
tools.description: Select all clips in the active sequence, or all clips on a specific track.

track_index.description: Specific track index (optional, selects all tracks if omitted)

tools.name: deselect_all_clips
tools.description: Deselect all clips in the active sequence.

tools.name: select_clips_in_range
tools.description: Select all clips that overlap a time range in the active sequence.

start_seconds.description: Start of selection range in seconds

end_seconds.description: End of selection range in seconds

tools.name: select_clips_by_color
tools.description: Select all clips whose source project item has a specific color label.

tools.name: invert_selection
tools.description: Invert the current clip selection in the active sequence (selected become deselected and vice versa).

tools.name: select_disabled_clips
tools.description: Select all disabled clips in the active sequence.
